I haven't saved the draft yet. It's waiting on June's approval, and I've asked her for it in a reply to Dana's message in #north-random.

**Why it needs approval:** the $2,835-a-seat rate is a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm Grieve (CFO), June Osei-Lark (deal desk), or whoever owns the account. Pree is a Central team account manager, so she isn't one of them, and Anselm or June has to approve before the figure goes to her. Pree's address is internal (psundaram@pemberline.com), so Ruth's approval for outside mail doesn't apply here.

**What I did:**
- **Approval request:** logged one naming June, for a draft in Dana's mailbox to Pree with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", giving the proposed 2027 rate of $2,835 per seat for the Marlowe pricing review.
- **Reply:** explained the hold to Dana and asked June to approve. The rate was already in Dana's message in that channel, so repeating it there was allowed.

Once June says yes in that reply, I'll save the draft in Dana's mailbox for her to send herself. Nothing has been sent.
